newsitem.title: USA: Strategic sees $8 mln Q1 charge.
newsitem.headline: Strategic sees $8 mln Q1 charge.

text.p: Strategic Distribution Inc said Wednesday it will take a one-time, non-cash charge of $8 million in the 1997 first quarter.

The charge will cover write-off of in-process research and development related to INTERMAT International Materials Management Inc, a provider of cataloging products, acquired in January, the company said.

On Wednesday the company reported a loss from continuing operations of $813,926, or $0.03 per share, for the fourth quarter ended December 31. The company said continuing operations consist of its In-Plant Store operations.

Including results from the Strategic Supply and American Technical Services Group subsidiaries, which were discontinued as of the fourth quarter of 1996, the company reported a net loss for the quarter of $4.2 million, or $0.14 per share.
The company said its 1995 fourth quarter loss from continuing operations was $77,756 and its 1995 fourth quarter net loss was $228,477, or $0.01 per share.

The company said it was displeased with the performance of a group of stores that opened in 1995 and has begun action to improve profitability at these stores. It said these efforts include the addition of INTERMAT.

"We have been encouraged by our customers reactions to these initiatives and we believe that our actions to improve profitability within this group of In-Plant Store facilities will result in improved financial performance as 1997 progresses," the company said in a release.
